description.content:
Given the Input parameters run's a Compliance check based on the Rule determined by the System and Action properties in the parameters. The type of Compliance Check is determined based on the Plugins configured in the Rule. For example: If the rule specifies the LicenseValidationPlugin the Compliance Check will consist of validating if the provided BrokerContact/BrokerAgency has an appropriate license matching the query parameters in the input.
             - Inputs
            {
                 "Parameters": 
            {
                 "System":"myBeazley", -The system making the call -used to determine the Rule
                 "Action":"BrokerNewBusinessQuote" - The action that triggers the call - used to determine the Rule
                 The combination of System and Action determines a lookup to a JSON configuration that determines and specifies:
                          1.ValidationRule - Which plugins will be executed for this query
                          2.ValidationTransforms - How the data in Input is mapped for each / all / particualr Plugin that gets executed.
                          3.AuditInputTransform - How the Auditing System will log(where / how is the data structured) the Input for this request
                          4.AuditOutputTransform - How the Auditing system will log(where / how is the data structured) the Output for this request
            },
              "Input": -This input is valid for The BrokerLicensePlugin based on the JsonConfiguration refered in the System / Action secetion.
             "{
                        "agency":"3930", - A UniqueId of the Broker Agency for which we want to check Broker Licenses
                        "productLine":"a0ee0bfb-a83e-e011-a864-0050568e000a\", - The Id of the Product Line for which we want to check licenses
                        "category":"admitted", - The Business Category for which we want to check licenses.
                        "country":"US", Tha Country for which we want to check licenses.
                        "state":"AK", The applicable state for which we want to check licenses.
                        "insuredName":"John Doe"
             }"
             Auditing Feature for Compliance.Get's stored as part of the Audit (Input/Output) determined by the JSON Cofiguration specified in the System/Action section.

For a given query object returns a collection of audit entries describing compliance checks that have been performed in the system. The parameters that can be passed to the audit report query are similar to the check parameters.Meaning that if we pass a specific product line the Audit Report will return Audit Entries for compliance checks that have been performed for that product. Additionally we can pass a Valid/Invalid/Both query parameter that will filter the Audit Entries based on the result of the compliance check.
             - Inputs 
             {
                 "page": 1,
                 "size": 25,
                 "filter": { - Filter contains the Audit Report Filters which separate into two groups.
                 "from": "2017-01-09T00:00:00.000Z", - From what datetime did the compliance check happen.
                 "to": "2017-01-09T14:39:00.000Z", - To what datetime did the compliance check happen.
                 "system": "Compliance.UI", - From what system did the check happen.
                 "action": "RunChecks", For what action
                 "user": "BFL\traja", For which user
                 "dataParameters": {
                          "isValid": "" - Empty string – Both valid and invalid
                          True – only valid checks
                          False – only invalid checks.
             }
            }}
             These filters are dynamic and used to narrow down the search results.Here we can populate from a standard set of possible filters matching information relevant to a compliance check.

The Audit Lookups endpoint is used to retrieve registry information relevant to performing lookups. For example it can be used with the key:”action” query to retrieve all possible action values for which Compliance Checks have happened with the purpose of displaying the actions in a dropdown list which the user can use to filter audit lookups. This matches the key with a column name in the Audits table and returns all unique values from all rows for that column. {"key":"system"} - The key matching the column
